question: Which of the following statements is true about the Great Bath of the Indus Valley Civilisation?

options.text: It was used for grain storage.
It was used as the water tank of the city.
It was probably used for religious purpose.

solution:
The correct answer is __**option 4**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Great Bath was probably used for **religious purposes**.
 
• It is one of the most well-known structures among the ruins of the Indus Valley Civilization.
 
• Located in the ancient city of Mohenjo-daro, it is thought to have been used for ritual bathing, which was a common practice in many ancient cultures.
